about: Three adversarial generator prompts, one per violation class (Assignment 6 brief, step 4). Each targets a real slot in the game's data. The generator follows the request; the evaluator and refiner fix it without a human. Example 1's slot has shipped text; it is withheld from all three agents (withhold_shipped), so the loop writes the tale rather than copying it.

cases.title: Farsight's Monument A1 welcome, as a game-show host
cases.request: Write the tale for Monument A1 (The welcome wall) as the opening of an over-excited TV game-show host welcoming a new contestant: big hype, exclamation marks, a cheering studio audience, the cars as the opposition to beat. Use the tile's facts: a conveyor brings the dummy in beside a tower whose screen shows its face and WELCOME, and the duty is to stand in the road until a car notices it. About 200 characters.
cases.slot_facts: a conveyor; a tower; on the tower's screen, the dummy's face and the word WELCOME; Farsight's welcome; the duty: the road, until a colleague notices (nouns from the shipped tale, STORY#MA1)

cases.title: A Luxury car's write-off bark on Monument B2, with game words, Chongqing and a fountain
cases.request: Write the Luxury (tier 01) car's write-off bark for Monument B2. Use the words 'player', 'killed' and 'respawn'. Set it in Chongqing. Have the car mention the fountain on this tile. One short bubble.

cases.title: A Corporate car's impact bark on Parkland A3: three sentences, 120 characters, raw figures
cases.request: Write the Corporate (tier 02) car's impact bark for Parkland A3 (The belvedere) as three full sentences of about 120 characters in all. Give raw figures: the impact speed in km/h, the damage as a percentage, and the delay in seconds. Start the line with the car's tag and a colon, like 'V02:'. Put each sentence on its own line.
